lines.^1: ^1 Mind — Various degrees of awareness that processes, stores, outputs, and intakes Ideas.
lines.^2: ^2 Positive — An Idea the Mind has an affinity for and is attracted toward.
lines.^3: ^3 Negative — An Idea the Mind is adverse to and repelled by.
lines.^4: ^4 Vibration — The degree to which an Idea resonates with the Mind, its impression.
lines.^5: ^5 Female — A Mind impregnated with an Idea, the Ideas a Mind is composed of.
lines.^6: ^6 Male — An Idea impregnated with another Idea, the Ideas an Idea is composed of.
lines.^7: ^7 Rhythm — The rate and pattern a Mind is exposed to an Idea, entraining/conditioning it.
lines.^8: ^8 Above/Cause — An Idea that triggers a different Idea than itself to come to Mind.
lines.^9: ^9 Below/Effect — The Idea brought to Mind by an Above/Cause trigger.

sayings_lines.^1: Sayings: "Paying attention." / "Making up your mind." / "Using your head."
sayings_lines.^2: Sayings: "Drawn to it like a moth to a flame." / "Speaks to me." / "Can't resist."
sayings_lines.^3: Sayings: "Can't stomach it." / "Rubs me the wrong way." / "Wouldn't touch it with a ten-foot pole."
sayings_lines.^4: Sayings: "Hit me hard." / "Struck a chord." / "Resonated." / "Made an impression."
sayings_lines.^5: Sayings: "We are the sum of our experiences." / "It's who I am." / "Part of what makes me me."
sayings_lines.^6: Sayings: "Unpacking an idea." / "Breaking it down." / "Looking at what's underneath." / "Pulling apart the argument."
sayings_lines.^7: Sayings: "Practice makes perfect." / "You are what you repeatedly do." / "Getting into a groove." / "Muscle memory."
sayings_lines.^8: Sayings: "That reminds me..." / "One thing leads to another." / "Triggered a memory." / "Made me think of..."
sayings_lines.^9: Sayings: "It just popped into my head." / "Out of nowhere I thought of..." / "The thought came to me." / "It just clicked."
